title: Implement keyed VSAM record and alternate-index semantics
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of vsam_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: KSDS WRITE inserts by the declared primary key without replacing the cluster; duplicate insert, missing rewrite/delete, changed rewrite key, and length errors return typed DUPREC, NOTFND, INVREQ, and LENGERR conditions.

READ, STARTBR, READNEXT, READPREV, and ENDBR use stable primary or alternate-key order. Cursors retain bounded logical-key/base-identity pairs, and CICS preserves the cursor and current base identity without a non-corpus CURSOR operand.
Alternate-index paths retain base-record identities, sorted duplicate order, UNIQUE/NONUNIQUE policy, and restartable metadata. All 13 runtime keyed paths and their exact key/record ranges validate.

Insert, rewrite, delete, every affected UPGRADE index generation, and the idempotency result use one atomic provider-state transaction. Intent-only restart safely retries; final replay does not apply a record twice.
The corpus receipt derives 58 reached file/browse statements plus four source AIX definitions for three unique NONUNIQUE UPGRADE indexes.

commands.result: focused pre-repair regression proved the second KSDS WRITE replaced the first record
